findings.what: The SWA deployment token is in the environment of the step that also runs `npm ci` for about 370 packages on a privileged self-hosted agent.
findings.why: --ignore-scripts blocks install scripts, so this is hardening only. Run `npm ci` in its own step, with no token env, and keep the token only on the `swa deploy` step.

findings.what: The new SWA CLI lockfile has no audit receipt. The only `npm audit` in the gate event covers src/Uinsure.Policies.Web, not infrastructure/pipelines/swa-cli.
findings.why: W7 supply chain: the lock is now the install surface on a privileged deploy agent. Add an `npm audit --prefix infrastructure/pipelines/swa-cli --audit-level=high` step to the Web stage or a gate. Not blocking.

API8:2023 met. staticwebapp.config.json adds frame-ancestors 'none' and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer to the existing CSP and nosniff. The CSP keeps default-src 'self', so there is no third-party origin. No secrets or local paths appear in the diff (greps for keys, tokens, user names and personal email were clean).

API10:2023 met. W1 grep over src/Uinsure.Policies.Web found no innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML (only a comment saying it is not used), eval or document.write. MarkdownText refuses non-allowlisted schemes.

SEC-1 referrer coverage has four layers. The SWA header is Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. index.html carries <meta name=referrer content=no-referrer>. The kit anchors carry rel=noreferrer. SiteSearch uses window.open(..., '_blank', 'noreferrer'). Gaps: kitchen-sink.html has neither a CSP nor a referrer meta, and the SWA header is not exercised by e2e, because dev and preview ignore staticwebapp.config.json. kitchen-sink.html is shipped in dist and is covered only by the SWA global headers.

Vite trace-on-start plugin: git runs through execFileSync with fixed args and no shell. It is skipped in mode 'test' and compiles only HEAD. A failed compile prints file:line plus a fixed reason (privacy.ts does not echo the matched text). /trace.json and /trace/* then return a constant 503 body, and no stale file is served. server.fs.allow=../.. is unchanged from before. Output goes to public/, which is now git-ignored, so the compiled trail is not committed.

SearchEntry split into route and repoPath (SiteSearch.tsx:20-21): a path opens only via blobUrl on the fixed github.com REPO. The raw-path fallback is reachable only when the trace is not ready, and the index is empty then. W2 holds.

SWA CLI lockfile: all 372 entries resolve to https://registry.npmjs.org/ with an sha512 integrity value. There are no git, http or file sources, and the deprecated notices were stripped without touching hashes. The deploy runs `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, the token reaches the CLI only through env, and `npx --yes` is gone (check-pipeline.py now enforces this). keytar is the only hasInstallScript package. Under --ignore-scripts its native binary is not built, which is good for security but may break `swa deploy` at runtime. I could not verify that, and it is a functional concern, not a security one.

stylelint 18.0.0-next.0 (prerelease, devDependency): the version is exact, it has a lockfile integrity entry and it is dev-only (never in dist). The lock diff removes micromatch, braces, fast-glob and globby, so the known dev-only GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm item in the web-security skill W7 no longer applies. That skill text is now stale and should be updated by the harness owner. The gate.green event shows `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` with exit 0 (runtime deps). The dev-tree audit result is not recorded in the gate event, so I cannot confirm the new tree has no high in dev.
W5: grep found no network calls, no .claude reads and no process.env in the compiler. The privacy denylist is unchanged.
W6: no local absolute paths or personal emails in the diff (grep clean).
W8: the dev-server error text is a constant, and the workbench problem display is unchanged.

The diff is mostly an 850-file rename (src/web to src/Uinsure.Policies.Web, tests/web to tests/Uinsure.Policies.Web.Tests). The harness hook path updates (guard-bash.mjs, roles.mjs) only retarget the allowlists and do not loosen them.
